   number on the page (Asana 1217072657902270). Behaviour, not motion: runs at
   DOM-ready whatever GSAP or prefers-reduced-motion say, before the kit's
   counters read data-count (the boot gate guarantees that order). */
WZ.onReady(function () {
  var OFFER = {
    /* Live offers published on grandmissiondentistry.com (2026-08-05). */
    newPatient: 189, /* exam, X-rays, cleaning, treatment plan */
    invisalign: 3799, /* aligners, refinements, retainer, whitening */
    /* The cosmetic campaign's own call-tracking number, as published on the
       vendor original — distinct from the implant page's, which is the point
       of tracking numbers. OPEN with Brandklout: if it belongs to the
       outgoing ad company it may be disconnected at handover. Fallback is
       the main line, (281) 789-8836 / +12817898836. */
    phoneDisplay: '(281) 729-4615',
    phoneDial: '+12817294615',
  };
  /* GHL lead destination — null until Brandklout hands over the endpoint. */
  var LEAD_ENDPOINT = null;
  var THANK_YOU_URL = null;

  var text = {
    'new-patient-value': OFFER.newPatient.toLocaleString('en-US'),
    'invisalign-value': OFFER.invisalign.toLocaleString('en-US'),
  };
  Object.keys(text).forEach(function (key) {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-offer="' + key + '"]').forEach(function (el) {
      el.textContent = text[key];
    });
  });

  /* Counters get the number, not the string. */
  var counters = { 'new-patient': OFFER.newPatient, invisalign: OFFER.invisalign };
  Object.keys(counters).forEach(function (key) {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-offer-count="' + key + '"]').forEach(function (el) {
      el.setAttribute('data-count', String(counters[key]));
      el.textContent = counters[key].toLocaleString('en-US');
    });
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-tel]').forEach(function (el) {
    el.textContent = OFFER.phoneDisplay;
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-tel-link]').forEach(function (el) {
    el.setAttribute('href', 'tel:' + OFFER.phoneDial);
  });

  /* ---------- lead form -------------------------------------------------- */
  var panel = document.getElementById('book');
  var form = document.getElementById('leadForm');
  var submit = document.getElementById('formSubmit');
  if (!panel || !form) return;

  form.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!validate()) return;

    /* Honeypot: a bot fills every field it finds, a patient never sees it. */
    if (form.company_website && form.company_website.value) return;

    var data = {};
    new FormData(form).forEach(function (value, key) { data[key] = value; });
    data.page = 'cosmetic-landing-page';
    data.asana_task_gid = '1217072657902270';

    var finish = function () {
      panel.classList.add('is-done');
      if (window.ScrollTrigger) ScrollTrigger.refresh();
      if (window.WZ && WZ.smoother) WZ.smoother.scrollTo(panel, true, 'center center');
      else panel.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });
    };

    if (!LEAD_ENDPOINT) {
      console.info('[lead] would POST to GHL:', data);
      finish();
      return;
    }

    submit.disabled = true;
    submit.querySelector('span').textContent = 'Sending…';
    fetch(LEAD_ENDPOINT, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(data),
    })
      .then(function () {
        if (THANK_YOU_URL) { window.location.href = THANK_YOU_URL; return; }
        finish();
      })
      .catch(function () {
        submit.disabled = false;
        submit.querySelector('span').textContent = 'Request my consultation';
        var slot = form.querySelector('[data-error-for="f-consent"]');
        if (slot) slot.textContent = 'Something went wrong. Please call the practice instead.';
      });
  });

  function validate() {
    form.querySelectorAll('[aria-invalid]').forEach(function (el) {
      el.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
    });
    form.querySelectorAll('.field__error').forEach(function (el) { el.textContent = ''; });

    var ok = true;
    form.querySelectorAll('input[required]').forEach(function (input) {
      var valid =
        input.type === 'checkbox'
          ? input.checked
          : input.value.trim() !== '' && input.checkValidity();
      if (!valid) {
        ok = false;
        input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
        var slot = form.querySelector('[data-error-for="' + input.id + '"]');
        if (slot) {
          slot.textContent =
            input.type === 'checkbox'
              ? 'Please agree to the terms so we can contact you.'
              : input.value.trim() === ''
              ? 'This one is required.'
              : 'Please check this is correct.';
        }
      }
    });
    return ok;
  }
});
</script>

<style>*{box-sizing:border-box}*::before{box-sizing:border-box}*::after{box-sizing:border-box}.wz-js{display:none}</style><script class="wz-js" data-embed="">
/* CHAPTER 02 — THE WORK (pinned, scrubbed index): a marker travels the
   service index and the stage changes to whatever it has reached. */
WZ.add(function (W) {
  var pin = document.getElementById('workPin');
  var rows = gsap.utils.toArray('[data-svc]');
  var marker = document.getElementById('workMarker');
  var card = document.getElementById('workCard');
  var icon = document.getElementById('workIcon');
  var title = document.getElementById('workTitle');
  var tag = document.getElementById('workTag');
  var num = document.getElementById('workNum');
  var rail = document.getElementById('workRail');
  var index = document.getElementById('workIndex');
  if (!pin || !rows.length || !marker) return;

  var current = -1;

  var show = function (i) {
    if (i === current) return;
    current = i;
    var row = rows[i];
    /* The stage swaps rather than cross-fades: one element, one owner of
       opacity, so nothing can be stranded half-visible. */
    gsap.fromTo(
      card,
      { opacity: 0, y: 18 },
      { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: 'power3.out', overwrite: true }
    );
    icon.src = row.getAttribute('data-icon');
    title.textContent = row.textContent.trim();
    tag.textContent = row.getAttribute('data-tag');
    num.textContent = String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    rows.forEach(function (r, j) { r.classList.toggle('is-on', j === i); });
  };

  var paint = function (p) {
    /* The marker is the continuous readout: it travels the whole index in
       step with scroll, independently of which row happens to be active. */
    var span = index.clientHeight - marker.clientHeight;
    gsap.set(marker, { y: span * p });
    show(Math.min(rows.length - 1, Math.floor(p * rows.length * 0.999)));
    if (rail) gsap.set(rail, { scaleX: p });
  };

  var mm = gsap.matchMedia();
  mm.add('(min-width: 760px)', function () {
    return W.scrub(
      { trigger: pin, start: 'top top', end: '+=190%', pin: true, scrub: 0.3, anticipatePin: 1, invalidateOnRefresh: true },
      paint
    );
  });
  mm.add('(max-width: 759px)', function () {
    return W.scrub({ trigger: pin, start: 'top 78%', end: 'bottom 55%', scrub: 0.35 }, paint);
  });
});
/* Without the pin the index cannot drive the stage, so the six services
   become a plain list and the stage shows the first of them. */
WZ.staticPaint(function () {
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-svc]').forEach(function (r) { r.classList.add('is-on'); });
});
</script>

Our cosmetic dentist in Richmond, TX is here to help you create your brand new, mega-watt smile, one that is unique to you. /* CHAPTER 04 — THE PROOF (pinned horizontal ribbon): eight real cases
   travel sideways. */
WZ.add(function (W) {
  var pin = document.getElementById('proofPin');
  var rail = document.getElementById('ribbonRail');
  var bar = document.getElementById('ribbonBar');
  if (!pin || !rail) return;

  function distance() {
    return Math.max(0, rail.scrollWidth - window.innerWidth + 40);
  }

  var mm = gsap.matchMedia();
  mm.add('(min-width: 901px)', function () {
    var cases = gsap.utils.toArray('.case');
    gsap.to(rail, {
      x: function () { return -distance(); },
      ease: 'none',
      scrollTrigger: {
        trigger: pin,
        start: 'top top',
        end: function () { return '+=' + (distance() + window.innerHeight * 0.6); },
        pin: true,
        scrub: 0.3,
        anticipatePin: 1,
        invalidateOnRefresh: true,
        onUpdate: function (self) {
          gsap.set(bar, { scaleX: self.progress });
          /* Whichever case is nearest the middle is the one being looked
             at, so it is the one that comes up to full colour. */
          var mid = window.innerWidth / 2;
          var best = 0,
            bestD = Infinity;
          cases.forEach(function (c, i) {
            var r = c.getBoundingClientRect();
            var d = Math.abs(r.left + r.width / 2 - mid);
            if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = i; }
          });
          cases.forEach(function (c, i) { c.classList.toggle('is-centre', i === best); });
        },
      },
    });
    /* No kill here — matchMedia already owns this tween and its pin;
       reverting it twice strips the pin spacer out of the layout. */
    return function () { gsap.set(bar, { scaleX: 1 }); };
  });

  mm.add('(max-width: 900px)', function () {
    var onScroll = function () {
      var max = rail.scrollWidth - rail.clientWidth;
      gsap.set(bar, { scaleX: max > 0 ? rail.scrollLeft / max : 1 });
    };
    onScroll();
    rail.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    return function () { rail.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll); };
  });
});
</script>
